retention.stated: Raw files are deleted after 48 hours; only chunked embeddings persist, and there is no documented route to reassemble originals

egress.terms: Storage free, query-time embeddings free. You pay only indexing embeddings ($0.15 / 1M tokens) and context tokens on retrieval.

chaining: Multiple stores per project, but the project-wide total is the cap. 'File Search store size is computed on the backend … typically approximately 3 times the size of your input data' — so 1 TB of Tier 3 store ≈ 340 GB of input. On free tier, 1 GB store ≈ 333 MB of input.
limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MB. 'Recommendation: Limit the size of each File Search store to under 20 GB'. No TTL on embeddings — they persist until manually deleted or the model is deprecated.
reliability_note: Embeddings are not bytes. Raw files are deleted after 48 hours; only chunked embeddings persist, and there is no documented route to reassemble originals. The 3x expansion factor is the trap — the marketing number understates the cost of the input by 3x. Free tier at 1 GB is below the brief's floor by a factor of 500.
